articles.title: Air power deters, but enduring outcomes in conflict need more
articles.summary: The US-Israel air campaign against Iran demonstrates both the strategic power and inherent limits of air-delivered retribution. It highlights how air strikes can penetrate deep, precisely hit critical nodes, and signal strong resolve. For SSB aspirants, this case study offers insights into the strategic application and effectiveness of air power in international conflicts, emphasizing its dual nature.

articles.title: Modi Walks Fine Line Between Iran and US as War Hits Economy
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi is enhancing India's engagement with Iran amidst escalating Middle East conflicts causing significant gas shortages and threatening national economic growth. This strategic move highlights India's focus on diversifying energy sources and securing critical imports, crucial for national development and maintaining geopolitical stability in the region. The approach demonstrates proactive foreign policy addressing energy security challenges.
